faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Professor posts at MGU?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Assistant Professor positions at Mahatma Gandhi University is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor at MGU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Assistant Professor post at Mahatma Gandhi University in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for MGU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their complete application and required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Professor post will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria for all Assistant Professor posts are as per UGC norms. Specific details can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants for the Assistant Professor positions is 70 years.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for MGU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Which subjects have vacancies for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available for Hindi, History, Mathematics, Microbiology/Biotechnology, Environmental Science, and Physics.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section on this page, which will be provided in the official website.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Mahatma Gandhi University?
faq.answer: The official website of Mahatma Gandhi University is www.mgu.ac.in. You can visit it for more information and updates.
